what: While a text section stays pinned to the screen, the next section rises from below and passes over it, and meanwhile a screen-height plate laid at the section bottom spreads as a center circle from 0 → 71% (screen diagonal end) — over two screens, starting once the next section’s head passes half the screen, tied to scroll with no curve. A section transition where an apricot-colored circle spreads to become the next section’s background

options.length: Distance over which the circle fully spreads (ScrollTrigger end), default 「+=200% — original culture section 200%, product section 100%
options.start: Where the spread begins, default ‹top bottom-=50%” (next section’s top at half the screen)
options.max: Radius of fully spread circle (%), default 71
options.pin: If off, it does not stick and only the circle spreads
options.--fx-fill: Circle fill (via style), a two-layer radial gradient mixing the default --kf-accent-soft into the background — when covering with the current background color (var(--active-bg-color)) as in product sections, that color is used

use: <section data-fx="circle-spread-pin">…text…</section><section style="padding-top: calc(750px + 50svh)">Next section</section> — While pinned there is no offset spacing, so leave the top of the next section empty
note: In the original the STUDIO section is a flex parent, so ScrollTrigger pinSpacing is off while it sticks, and the next section clears space with padding-top calc(750px + 50svh) — the part is also attached with no spacing gap
